single.rationale: Vitesse shows deteriorating profitability despite recent revenue recovery, with operating margins collapsing from 55% (2022) to just 6% (2025) and concerningly weak returns on equity at 4%. The company faces structural headwinds including significant share dilution (20% YoY), commodity price sensitivity, and substantial proved undeveloped reserves that require capital deployment under uncertain pricing conditions.
